codeReview.summary: The product change is correctly scoped: adding `"cow"` to `Renumbering.get_allowed_species()` is sufficient because cow aliases, HMMs, and germline data were already present in the repository, and the worker added focused species-contract coverage around the new allowlist entry. I found no high-confidence blocking defect in the implementation, but two of the new tests are weaker than the feature contract they claim to enforce.

issues.description: `test_cow_hmms_load_successfully()` only checks that at least one loaded HMM name contains `"cow"`. The feature description explicitly called for verifying `cow_H.hmm`, `cow_K.hmm`, and `cow_L.hmm`; this assertion would still pass if only one cow chain model loaded.

`test_cow_vh_produces_numbered_result()` uses `result.shape[1] > 5` as a proxy for Kabat numbering, but VAL-EXP-002 requires non-empty Kabat position assignments. Because that shape check can pass from metadata columns alone, the test does not actually prove Kabat positions were populated.

summary: Pass. The implementation cleanly enables cow renumbering support via the existing HMM and germline assets, with only non-blocking gaps in the strength of two new contract tests.
